description: Regional Movers Index is a report listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Regional Australia Institute. The Regional Australia Institute (RAI) in association with the Commonwealth Bank created an analysis of population movement between Australia's Capital Cities and Regions, powered by analysis of proprietary data to create an up-to-date picture of a large sample of relocations. Data spans National as well as Greater Capital City Statistical Area (GCCSA) and Local Government Areas (LGA). Updated quarterly, data ranges from 2018 to 2022. Coverage is Australia, 2018 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as quarterly, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
